title: The World of Tom Clancy's The Division
summary: Dark Horse and Ubisoft's official Division reference book, framing SHD history, training, structure, tools and mission across the first two games.

claims.text: The World of Tom Clancy's The Division is an official Dark Horse and Ubisoft reference book produced in collaboration with the game's developers.
Ubisoft describes the book as a lore guide to the Strategic Homeland Division's classified history, training and structure, alongside its tactics, equipment and mission.
Ubisoft's preview places the lore book in the Division universe and identifies a timeline spanning the period between the first and second games.

paragraphs.text: This is a reference and art book, not a standalone campaign or a source for reconstructed game scenes. Dark Horse and Ubisoft present it as a developer-collaboration guide to the Division universe.

sections.heading: What it anchors in the archive

paragraphs.text: The book gives high-level context for the SHD's mission, organization and preparedness. Its official Ubisoft summary is used here only as an evidence locator for independently written records about the crisis framework; the archive does not reproduce its prose, artwork, layouts or timeline pages.

verification.notes: Official product and Ubisoft material establish the book and its high-level scope. Public archive text contains original summaries and source links only; no pages, art, excerpts, OCR or downloadable edition are published.
